minimality_note: The retained files are the smallest reproduced Wan and HunyuanVideo text-to-video paths that reach the excised hooks across the workload prompts. Other model families, experiment frontends, unrelated media, tests, and the vendored FlashInfer source are omitted; only the CUDA header subset required by the retained SM90a build remains. examples/7/prompt.txt is retained only because the byte-identical HunyuanVideo shell entrypoint reads it; the evaluator replaces that prompt with the workload record.
